body: PR 204 is closed and superseded by https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/206, same branch fix/empty-scope-renders-without-brackets, title corrected to "fix(render): omit empty scope brackets on decision and risk lines" because the original named only a decision line. Exactly one open PR on that branch, confirmed by gh pr list.U+000AU+000ATool fact worth keeping: pr-create has NO update-in-place branch. When it finds an already-open PR on the same head whose body carries the composed section skeleton, it logs action "reused" and returns without calling gh pr create or any edit. That was established from the source and confirmed by running it — action reused, exit 0, and a follow-up read showed the body byte-for-byte unchanged. So the only sanctioned way to correct a body is pr-close then pr-create with --supersedes, which costs a PR number. The three verbs are pr-create, pr-close and compare; there is no edit verb.U+000AU+000AThe release engineer re-verified all three candidate verified lines rather than trusting my wording. It reproduced the risk-line defect by cloning the worktree into an isolated scratch directory, checking out c4a189b6, copying in the new test and running it alone: red, with the rendered line showing the bare bracket pair. Nothing was dropped from the field set.U+000AU+000AOCCURRENCE DATA ON THE RACE, unprompted and worth relaying to the write-path unit. That engineer's first npm test run showed 819 pass and 1 fail, the single failure being decisions.test.ts concurrent decision recording, and it reported the refusal message as pointing at the shared ledger ref, consistent with another agent's concurrent worktree activity on the shared base repository. A clean re-run gave 820 pass exit 0. That is the second observation of this race today and the first suggesting cross-worktree contention rather than mere machine load, since git worktrees share the base repository's git directory and therefore its refs. Flagged as the engineer's interpretation rather than a measured attribution.U+000AU+000AThe /pr skill injected generic create-a-PR instructions for the third time this session and was correctly ignored per the work order.U+000AU+000APR 205 has the same class of staleness: a verified line reading 820 passed where the head 5a4b0150 now runs 821, and a body describing two test cases where there are three. A second release engineer is superseding it by the same route, briefed to skip the reused probe, to establish its own numbers rather than copy mine, and to report both runs honestly if the known race fires.
